regulations.area: Bodega Bay to Point Reyes · California · San Francisco Groundfish Management Area
regulations.scope: Reviewed 2026 recreational boat fishing text for the San Francisco outer coast; current source health, position, method and area access remain separate gates.
common_notes: Recreational boat fishing on the San Francisco outer coast only; San Francisco Bay has different rules. California anglers age 16 and older need a fishing license.
Species and group limits, method rules, MPAs and federal conservation areas still control at the exact position. A season window does not clear a route, harbor entrance or current advisory.
The salmon opening begins at 38°02′ N and is not a Bodega-wide season; crab reopening is scheduled only and requires a new gear/health review.

rules-gear.name: CDFW finfish gear and general rules
rules-gear.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW July 2026 finfish gear text: one line and at most two hooks with lingcod or rockfish aboard; salmon north of Point Conception has its own one-rod and barbless-hook rule.

rules-invertebrates.name: CDFW invertebrate gear rules
rules-invertebrates.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed current CDFW section 29.80 crab gear text: trap validation, deployment limit, marking, pre-opener prohibition and servicing requirements; season permission remains separate.

rules-whales.name: CDFW whale-safe crab restrictions
rules-whales.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW 2026–27 Whale Safe Fisheries page: recreational Dungeness season currently closed; any future trap authorization requires the current zone decision.

rules-health.name: CDFW fishery health closures
rules-health.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW health-closure page and dated September 2026 advisories; no listed Bodega target-specific closure was converted into a season opening or entrance clearance.

rules-ocean.name: CDFW official regulation index
rules-ocean.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW 2026 ocean index and official regional, in-season, health and species links; the index is a navigation source, not independent permission to fish.

rules-groundfish.name: CDFW groundfish
rules-groundfish.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW groundfish summary: San Francisco area all-depth Apr–Dec season, descending device and Cordell Bank all-groundfish prohibition; exact closure geometry remains separate.

rules-inseason.name: CDFW in-season changes
rules-inseason.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW in-season page through September 11: August San Francisco summer salmon closure did not change the September fall opening; May Fishing Zone 3 trap action requires new gear clearance.

rules-salmon.name: CDFW salmon
rules-salmon.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW 2026 fall salmon page: September 1–October 31 only from 38°02′ N to Pigeon Point, 20,000 Chinook guideline, two fish excluding coho and north-coast barbless gear.

rules-crab.name: CDFW crab
rules-crab.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW permanent redirect to the canonical crab page and its September 24 recreational regulations and FAQ. The normalized content hash matches the previously reviewed source; current season, gear, whale and health checks remain separate.

rules-book.name: CDFW 2026 ocean sport fishing booklet
rules-book.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed original 2026 CDFW ocean booklet sections and tables for California halibut, Dungeness, albacore, finfish possession and gear; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-proposals.name: California FGC rulemaking: effective and pending changes
rules-proposals.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed FGC 2026 rulemaking index: proposed recreational conformance action has pending adoption and no effective date, so it was not treated as operative law.

rules-tuna-federal.name: Federal recreational Pacific tuna rules · 50 CFR 660.721
rules-tuna-federal.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed current eCFR 50 CFR 660.721: 25 albacore north of Point Conception, 10 if trip enters southern EEZ, 24-hour/calendar-day and onboard restrictions.

rules-salmon-pdf.name: CDFW 2026 ocean salmon season flyer · August update
rules-salmon-pdf.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed original August 2026 CDFW salmon flyer: fall latitude band, 20-inch minimum, two-fish bag, no coho, single rod and barbless hook restrictions; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-groundfish-pdf.name: CDFW San Francisco groundfish season table
rules-groundfish-pdf.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed original June 23 San Francisco groundfish table: Apr–Dec all depths, lingcod two at 22 inches, RCG ten with sublimits and four no-retention rockfish; PDF fingerprint verified.

rules-pacific-halibut.name: CDFW Pacific halibut season and quota
rules-pacific-halibut.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW Pacific halibut page to distinguish it from California halibut; one-fish Pacific rule and south-of-Point-Arena quota season are not assigned to the California-halibut card.

rules-san-francisco.name: CDFW San Francisco outer-coast rules
rules-san-francisco.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed September 1 CDFW outer-coast page: Point Arena–Pigeon Point jurisdiction, 38°02′ salmon line, California-halibut two at 22 inches and scheduled November 7 Dungeness opener.

mpa-point-reyes.name: CDFW Point Reyes MPAs and special closure
mpa-point-reyes.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW Point Reyes SMR, SMCA and Headlands Special Closure: no take in SMR, only salmon trolling or Dungeness trap in SMCA, and restricted Headlands entry.

rules-cordell.name: CDFW Cordell Bank groundfish restriction
rules-cordell.review_note: Rechecked the current exact official source; its normalized content hash matches the previous reviewed text. Reviewed CDFW groundfish summary statement prohibiting all groundfish fishing at Cordell Bank; the exact federal exclusion footprint remains a separate geometry gate.

mpa-duxbury.name: CDFW Duxbury Reef SMCA
mpa-duxbury.review_note: Read current CDFW Duxbury Reef SMCA page: finfish take exception is from shore only, so it does not permit boat fishing; conservatively exclude its full mapped polygon.

mpa-double-point.name: CDFW Double Point/Stormy Stack Rock special closure
mpa-double-point.review_note: Read current CDFW Double Point/Stormy Stack Rock special-closure page: no entry without agency authorization, with official coordinates and access rules; exclude the mapped polygon.

mpa-montara-pillar.name: CDFW Montara SMR and Pillar Point SMCA
mpa-montara-pillar.review_note: Read current CDFW Montara SMR/Pillar Point SMCA page: Montara is no-take; Pillar Point has method- and species-specific exceptions including Dungeness trap and pelagic trolling. Exclude both conservatively from app targets.

mpa-egg-rock.name: CDFW Egg Rock to Devils Slide special closure
mpa-egg-rock.review_note: Read current CDFW Egg Rock to Devils Slide special-closure page: entry is restricted except authorized officials or permission; additional transit limits apply. Exclude the mapped closure.

mpa-north-farallon.name: CDFW North Farallon Islands SMR and special closure
mpa-north-farallon.review_note: Read current CDFW North Farallon Islands page: SMR is no-take and the separate special closure restricts entry, anchoring and transit. Exclude both; the source GeoJSON nested shells need conservative union.

mpa-southeast-farallon.name: CDFW Southeast Farallon Island SMR, SMCA and special closure
mpa-southeast-farallon.review_note: Read current CDFW Southeast Farallon Island page: SMR no-take; SMCA allows salmon trolling only; special closure restricts entry and boating. Exclude all conservatively; repair nested GeoJSON shells only by union of all components.

mpa-point-arena-sea-lion.name: CDFW Point Arena and Sea Lion Cove marine areas
mpa-point-arena-sea-lion.review_note: Read CDFW current page: Point Arena SMR bans take, Point Arena SMCA permits salmon trolling only, Sea Lion Cove SMCA permits finfish. All three mapped polygons remain excluded from app fishing targets.

mpa-saunders.name: CDFW Saunders Reef SMCA
mpa-saunders.review_note: Read CDFW Saunders Reef SMCA current page: recreational salmon trolling is the only stated recreational take exception. Full polygon remains excluded from app fishing targets.

mpa-del-mar.name: CDFW Del Mar Landing SMR
mpa-del-mar.review_note: Read CDFW Del Mar Landing SMR current page: no take of living, geological or cultural marine resources. The full mapped polygon remains excluded.

mpa-stewarts.name: CDFW Stewarts Point marine areas
mpa-stewarts.review_note: Read CDFW Stewarts Point current page: SMR is no-take; SMCA permits specified recreational hook-and-line finfish and other listed methods. Both polygons remain excluded from app fishing targets.

mpa-salt-gerstle.name: CDFW Salt Point and Gerstle Cove marine areas
mpa-salt-gerstle.review_note: Read CDFW Salt Point and Gerstle Cove current page: Gerstle Cove SMR is no-take; Salt Point SMCA permits recreational finfish and abalone subject to fishery closure. Both polygons remain excluded.

mpa-russian-river.name: CDFW Russian River marine areas
mpa-russian-river.review_note: Read CDFW Russian River current page: SMCA permits Dungeness trap and surf smelt net take; SMRMA permits waterfowl only. Both polygons remain excluded from app fishing targets.

lingcod.name: Lingcod
lingcod.season: Apr 1–Dec 31, 2026 · boat fishing at all depths in the San Francisco Management Area.
lingcod.bag: 2 per person daily and in possession, separate from the 10-fish rockfish/cabezon/greenling complex.
details: When lingcod or rockfish are aboard, use only one line with no more than two hooks.
Carry a descending device ready for immediate use when taking or possessing federal groundfish from a boat.
Lingcod fillets aboard must be at least 14 in long with all skin attached.
Cordell Bank groundfish fishing is prohibited; check exact MPAs and other area restrictions.

rod.note: One line and at most two hooks when lingcod or rockfish are aboard.

rockfish.name: Rockfish
rockfish.season: Apr 1–Dec 31, 2026 · boat fishing at all depths in the San Francisco Management Area.
rockfish.bag: 10 total rockfish, cabezon and greenlings combined per person daily and in possession.
rockfish.size: No minimum length for retained rockfish; identify the species.
details: Within the 10-fish complex: at most 1 copper, 2 canary and 2 vermilion/sunset rockfish combined.
Do not retain bronzespotted, cowcod, quillback or yelloweye rockfish.
When rockfish or lingcod are aboard, use only one line with no more than two hooks. Carry a descending device ready for immediate use.
Retained rockfish fillets aboard must have all skin attached. Cordell Bank groundfish fishing is prohibited.

rod.note: One line and at most two hooks when rockfish or lingcod are aboard.

halibut.name: California halibut
halibut.season: Year-round for California halibut in the San Francisco outer-coast management area.
halibut.bag: 2 California halibut per person daily and in possession north of Point Sur.
details: California halibut is distinct from Pacific halibut, which has a separate quota and rules.
Carry a landing net for undersize fish; do not gaff a fish below the minimum size.
Aboard a vessel south of Point Arena, retained halibut fillets must be at least 16¾ in long with all skin attached.
Rockfish, lingcod or salmon aboard can impose stricter hook and line rules.

rod.note: General ocean hook-and-line rules apply; other fish aboard can impose stricter gear limits.

salmon.name: Ocean salmon
salmon.season: Sep 1–Oct 31, 2026 only from 38°02′ N near Point Reyes south to Pigeon Point; may close earlier at the 20,000-Chinook harvest guideline.

geography.note: The 2026 fall opening in this management area runs only from 38°02′ N near Point Reyes to Pigeon Point (37°11′ N), and may close early at the harvest guideline.

salmon.bag: 2 salmon per person daily, except coho; no more than one daily bag limit aboard in ocean waters.
salmon.size: 20 in minimum total length during the 2026 fall season.
details: The Bodega-side waters north of 38°02′ N are outside this fall opening. The selected point or entire area must be south of that line.
In-season action can close the fishery before Oct 31; check CDFW immediately before fishing.

North of Point Conception, use one rod and no more than two single-point, single-shank barbless hooks when fishing for salmon or with salmon aboard. Bait other than while trolling requires barbless circle hooks, hard-tied no more than 5 in apart.
Do not retain coho or steelhead and do not fillet salmon aboard.

rod.note: One rod; at most two single-point, single-shank barbless hooks north of Point Conception. Bait other than trolling requires barbless circle hooks.

dungeness.name: Dungeness crab
dungeness.season: Closed now. Scheduled to reopen Nov 7, 2026 in this area, subject to health and gear decisions.
dungeness.bag: When open: 10 Dungeness crabs per person daily and in possession.
dungeness.size: 5¾ in minimum shell width, measured directly in front of and excluding the side spines.
details: No recreational take or possession while the season is closed. Recheck the actual opener, health advisories and whale-safe gear decisions.
Crab-trap validation, buoy/GO ID marks, escape rings, destruct device and deployment limits apply to traps. Trap permission is separate from season permission.
Crab traps may not be deployed in the seven days before the season opens; service deployed traps at intervals no greater than nine days, weather permitting.
Point Reyes SMCA allows Dungeness by trap only; the nearby SMR prohibits take and the Headlands Special Closure restricts entry.

trap.note: Season and current whale-safe trap clearance are separate.

hoop.note: Check hoop-net marking, inspection intervals, season and health advisories before setting gear.

snare.note: Check snare-loop and season rules before setting gear.

albacore.name: Albacore tuna
albacore.season: Year-round under the reviewed 2026 rules for offshore U.S. waters north of Point Conception.
albacore.bag: 25 albacore per person daily and in possession north of Point Conception, in addition to the general 20-finfish limit.
albacore.size: No minimum size in the cited recreational rules.
details: If any part of the trip enters the U.S. EEZ south of 34°27′ N, the federal onboard limit is 10 albacore per person for that trip.
The federal limit applies per 24-hour period at sea and does not allow more than one daily bag in a calendar day; multi-day permits need separate review.
This card does not cover Mexican waters. Fish already aboard can impose stricter gear rules.

rod.note: General ocean hook-and-line rules apply; check trip-wide possession and other species aboard.

area_notices.name: Bodega Head and Point Reyes MPAs
area_notices.note: Current CDFW MPA geometry and individual exceptions require exact position and method review. No fishing target is published in this draft.

area_notices.name: Cordell Bank groundfish exclusion
area_notices.note: CDFW identifies a federal groundfish prohibition at Cordell Bank; exact applicable boundary and method require current federal rule review.

area_notices.name: Point Reyes–Pigeon Point MPAs and island access
area_notices.note: Point Reyes, Duxbury Reef, Montara, Pillar Point, Egg Rock and Farallon marine areas have different no-take, shore-only, salmon-trolling and no-entry rules. This preview excludes all mapped MPAs and special closures from fishing targets. Check exact official text and live island access before a trip.

area_notices.name: Point Arena to Russian River protected areas
area_notices.note: Eleven CDFW MPA polygons are displayed and conservatively excluded from fishing marks. Exceptions differ by area; check the linked current source and exact method before a trip. No fishing target is published in this preview.

limitations: Landing port is not a catch position; named grounds are broad reports, not GPS fixes.
Reports are a selected sample, with unknown effort and missing unsuccessful trips.
Satellite temperature and HF radar measure surface context, not bottom conditions.
Daily observations are not a seven-day bite forecast or live entrance clearance.
